title: NOTICE - ITC-1351-2026 - demonstration-cum-interaction session with regard to the AI based filing and registration system for the Paperless Courts
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 18/06/2026
physical mode on Saturday 20/06/2026 from 3:30 pm onwards at Conference
22/06/2026 onwards (Monday to Friday) between 5:30 pm to 6:30 pm:

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CELL
NOTICE
No. ITC/1351/2026
Date: 18/06/2026
As per the direction of the Hon'ble Chief Justice, this is to inform that
demonstration-cum-interaction session with regard to the AI based filing and
registration system for the Paperless Courts, with the representative members
of the Gujarat High Court Advocates' Association is scheduled to be held in
physical mode on Saturday 20/06/2026 from 3:30 pm onwards at Conference
Hall 4, 3rd Floor, Gujarat High Court Auditorium. Further, daily interaction in
virtual mode through the following Google Meet link will be made available from
22/06/2026 onwards (Monday to Friday) between 5:30 pm to 6:30 pm:
Google Meet Link: https://meet.google.com/dic-gudw-aae
Sd/-
I/c.Registrar (SCMS & ICT)
